# Animesh Singh

<div class="hero-subtitle">PhD Researcher · Computer Science and Engineering</div>

I am a PhD student in the **Department of Computer Science and Engineering at IIT Hyderabad**. My research focuses on **networked systems**, **eBPF program analysis**, and **correctness of network functions**.

I build tools to analyze deployed network programs and help operators understand their behavior. I am particularly interested in bytecode analysis and verification of composed network functions.

[Research](research.qmd){.btn .btn-primary} [Publications](publications.qmd){.btn .btn-outline-primary}
:::

## Research interests

::: {.grid-tiles}
::: {.research-tile}
### eBPF bytecode analysis

Static and path-sensitive analysis of eBPF programs without requiring the original source code.
:::

::: {.research-tile}
### Network function verification

Understanding correctness properties of routers, firewalls, load balancers, and their composition.
:::

::: {.research-tile}
### Networked systems

Building practical analysis methods for programmable and software-defined networks.
:::
:::
